newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romanian President Emil Constantinescu end its visit to France, due back in Bucharest later today.
* Romania's admission to NATO is just a matter of time, Alexandru Nicolae, head of parliament defence commision, said after U.S. visit. Romania enjoys support from the United States, he said.
* Upper Senate continues debates on wine and vineyard law.
* Lower chamber of Deputies resumed on traffic code.
